title: Due to nurse
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：due to　|　正文 364 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 due to 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the father kept the chair ① due to the long winter at the door, and everybody in the house said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the chair had been left ② due to the care of the old nurse, and nobody had asked a single question. The father had come to the house two months earlier and spoke little of the house he had left behind him.

The letter for September 1949 puts it plainer. It was done ③ due to the help of his brother, and the neighbour who kept the chair had carried it ④ due to the work of the doctor twice before the winter came; nothing in the house was ever done due to the help of his brother in those days. The neighbour wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ due to the want of rain, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ due to the need of the family; he was not a man who explained himself, and the house had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was that the chair be carried ⑦ due to the weight of the snow, and that the names be written ⑧ due to the pages of the ledger. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried due to the weight of the snow.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965 she kept the chair ⑨ due to the long winter again when nobody else would, and ⑩ due to the care of the old nurse, she said in 1967, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the chair in the same door for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the house never forgot what had been done due to the care of the old nurse.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 由于（表时间：due to the long winter）
B. prep. 由于（表处所：due to the care of the old nurse）
C. prep. 应归于（表方式／状态：due to the help of his brother）
D. prep. 应归于（引出施动者或相关的人：be carried due to the work of the doctor）
E. prep. 由于（表原因：due to the want of rain）
F. prep. 应归于（表对象／目的：due to the need of the family）
G. prep. 由于（表工具／材料：due to the weight of the snow）
H. prep. 应归于（表载体／处所：written due to the pages of the ledger）

items.q: due to the care of the old nurse
due to the help of his brother
due to the work of the doctor
due to the want of rain
due to the need of the family
due to the weight of the snow
due to the pages of the ledger
due to the long winter again
due to the care of the old nurse, she said

answers.why: due to 意为“由于”，此处引出时间 the long winter（那个漫长的冬天），说明那件小小的板凳是在何时留下的。
due to 意为“由于”，此处引出处所 the care of the old nurse（老护士的照料），说明东西被放在何处。
due to 意为“应归于”，此处引出方式或状态 the help of his brother（他兄弟的帮忙），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
due to 意为“应归于”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 大夫的诊治：be carried due to the work of the doctor。
due to 意为“由于”，此处引出原因 the want of rain（因为缺雨），说明整件事由何而起。
due to 意为“应归于”，此处引出对象或目的 the need of the family（家里的需要）。
due to 意为“由于”，此处引出工具或材料 the weight of the snow（积雪的重压）。
due to 意为“应归于”，此处引出载体 the pages of the ledger（账簿上的那些页）：names written due to the pages of the ledger。
due to 意为“由于”，1965 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的板凳，此处仍引出时间 the long winter。
due to 意为“由于”，母亲 1967 年那句话引出的仍是那一处老护士的照料。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年那个漫长的冬天前后，父亲把那件小小的板凳留在了门口。（due to the long winter）
那件小小的板凳被放在老护士的照料，谁也没有过问。（due to the care of the old nurse）
整件事是他兄弟的帮忙做成的，家书上写得明白。（due to the help of his brother）
入冬之前，那件小小的板凳已经由大夫的诊治搬过两回。（be carried due to the work of the doctor）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为缺雨起的。（due to the want of rain）
他说，家里从来没有人为家里的需要做过这件事。（due to the need of the family）
answers: In 1955 the father kept the chair due to the long winter at the door.
The chair had been left due to the care of the old nurse, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done due to the help of his brother, or so the letter says.
The chair had been carried due to the work of the doctor twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun due to the want of rain.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it due to the need of the family.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1955 the father kept the chair due to the long winter, and nobody forgot it.
The chair had been left due to the care of the old nurse for three months.
The work was done due to the help of his brother, as it always was in those days.
The chair had been carried due to the work of the doctor twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the chair due to the long winter again when nobody else would.
The whole house never forgot what had been done due to the care of the old nurse.
